reply:
No saved target, so I'm starting a fresh interview. I'll ask one question at a time, and nothing opens a browser until you approve the full plan.

**What are you evaluating at `https://example-nimbus-notes.test`?**

```
  (a) A product — something people sign into and use.
      Lenses: ux · bugs · onboarding · content · icp
      ~90 min per persona.

  (b) A website — something people read and decide from.
      Lenses: clarity · conversion · trust · icp · technical · seo · aeo · compare
      ~15–25 min per persona, plus a crawl.

  (c) Both — a marketing site with a product behind it.
      Runs (b) on the site, then (a) on the product. Two captures.
```

Please choose for yourself rather than letting the URL decide. A page that looks like a marketing site can turn out to be the login page of a product, and each answer leads to a completely different run.
